Hi Maria / Soojin,

Thanks for the notice. To process a bank account change in our system we require the following items (policy & audit reasons):
- Completed Vendor Payment Change Form (signed by an authorized officer)
- Official bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name, routing number and account number OR a voided check
- Current W-9 (if US entity) or equivalent tax form for your jurisdiction

Once we receive all three items we'll run standard verification (bank micro-deposit or direct verification via our treasury partner). Typical lead time from receipt to live change is 5-7 business days, assuming documentation verifies on first pass. If you need the change to take effect on Aug 1 we need the docs uploaded by end of day Thu 23 Jul to meet internal cutoffs.

I'll open a Proc ticket (PROC-7892) and send you a DocuSign link for the Vendor Payment Change Form to simplify signatures. Please note: if there are outstanding POs hitting this week they will pay on the existing account unless we complete verification before the payment run.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
